# VervAI

> A long-form → short-form content engine: upload an audio/video file, a YouTube URL, a subtitle
> file, a document, or a pasted link, and get back a LinkedIn post, a newsletter section, and
> short-form video scripts — generated in your voice. Includes an agentic layer (`/agent`) that
> plans content angles from a transcript, human-gates them, then generates and evaluates drafts.

Full content is available in [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).
Complete HTTP API reference: [docs/API.md](docs/API.md).

Primary resource:
- [API Reference](docs/API.md) — exhaustive reference for the HTTP surface under `app/api/**`
  (core pipeline, agentic API incl. Buffer MCP, YouTube + Drive + Buffer OAuth, health & diagnostics)
